upsc_summary: PAIMANA (Project Assessment, Infrastructure Monitoring and Analytics for Nation-Building) is a web-based platform launched by MoSPI to monitor Central Sector infrastructure projects costing ₹150 crore or more, replacing OCMS-2006.

The PAIMANA-CRIP module serves as the Central Repository of Infrastructure Projects, replacing DPIIT's Integrated Project Monitoring Portal (IPMP) and feeding project data directly to PRAGATI and PMG.

Features a Performance Monitoring Dashboard developed with NIPFP and aligned with the Department of Economic Affairs' Harmonized Master List (HML) of Infrastructure (2022), tracking 165 indicators across 6 sub-sectors: Power, Civil Aviation, Telecommunications, Railways, Roads, and Ports, Shipping & Waterways.

Shift in infrastructure monitoring: Moves beyond simple output tracking to a multi-dimensional evaluation framework across five dimensions: Access, Quality, Fiscal Cost & Revenue, Utilization, and Affordability.

Key Infrastructure Data: As of June 2026, PAIMANA tracks 1,847 ongoing Central Sector projects with a revised cost of ₹40.54 lakh crore, including 769 mega projects (≥₹1,000 crore) and 1,078 major projects (₹150–₹1,000 crore).
